name: vfx-liquid-background
title: Liquid Page Waves
description: A page floats on a liquid surface: vertex waves and ripples roll across it with a slight camera tilt, intensify, and the page crossfades into a second one while the surface settles to still. WebGL over two built-in pages.
useWhen: A fluid, rippling crossfade between two screens, for product tours and app showcases.
A page that should feel alive on a liquid surface before it changes.
avoidWhen: Text-heavy screens that must stay perfectly readable during the transition.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Panel A cards
variables.description: Up to 4 cards as "Name | price | change", separated by semicolons.

variables.label: Panel B posts
variables.description: Up to 3 posts as "Name | text", separated by semicolons.

variables.description: Share of the frame size the scene is drawn at, then scaled up. Page text needs 0.75.
